label: Post-result DecontX ambient-RNA sensitivity for the already fixed 15-state family; not public preregistration, not confirmatory validation
question: Do the raw-count CT, TA and LGR5-positive stem state-family associations persist after a fixed DecontX sensitivity analysis?

input.background_empty_droplets: not available; H5AD has no raw group or count layers

cells.samples: same 82 sample libraries from 41 fixed UC colonic/rectal Pre/Post site pairs
cells.cell_rule: released cells with nonmissing final_analysis; predicted_doublets are all false in this fixed set
cells.batch_handling: run DecontX independently per sample_id because each sample is a distinct library/ambient pool

decontx.x: all genes by all retained cells within each sample, sparse dgCMatrix
decontx.seed: deterministic sample-specific seed derived from fixed manifest order
decontx.corrected_count_rule: retain non-integer posterior corrected counts; do not round
decontx.composition_rule: do not change cell labels or composition counts

state_family.states: same 15 released non-ileal epithelial final_analysis states
state_family.score: mean of six log2((decontX-corrected gene sum +0.5)/(decontX-corrected all-gene UMI+1)*1e6) values
state_family.eligibility: same at least20 raw labeled state cells in both visits of a site pair
state_family.unit: site Post-minus-Pre followed by equal-site patient mean
state_family.statistics: OLS95CI, HC3 P, exact patient-label permutation P
state_family.multiplicity: BH with n=15 fixed states; non-evaluable states remain NA

interpretation_rules.CT_TA_LGR5_all_q_lt_0_05: ambient-robust support for extending the state-family observation to CT, TA and LGR5-positive stem
interpretation_rules.CT_q_lt_0_05_but_TA_or_LGR5_not: retain CT within-state result and report each other state individually; remove broad cross-lineage claim
interpretation_rules.CT_q_ge_0_05: headline CT within-state association is ambient-sensitive
interpretation_rules.always: DecontX without empty droplets is a model-based sensitivity, not proof of zero ambient RNA; no causal, unique-program or replacement-validation claim

mandatory_reporting: raw versus DecontX estimates and q values
contamination distributions by sample and state
threshold20 and at most6 remission patients
three threshold20-ineligible patients are all non-remission; eligibility may be informative
threshold10 raw branch crosses zero and the prespecified threshold20 branch is strongest
no_tuning: no change to clusters, state family, threshold, genes, score or multiplicity after DecontX results
